about: The Editor's last Claude review (house style, facts, tone, premium visuals).
summary: No Never-list breaches in the captions, but the Wild Nine post (2026-11-24-tue) falls short of the premium visual standard and is held; only that post's images were supplied, so the other 10 were reviewed on text only.
points: 2026-11-24-tue (thumbnail): raw game screenshot with UI cut off at the edges ('Island Green', 'Tee', '11 mph', 'hape' half-visible) and a stray in-game tag ('Full Swing. Not full price.') sitting right above the title. Fix: crop tightly to the course art or rebuild on a clean background so nothing is clipped, and make the thumbnail 2-4 big words with nothing important outside the middle 4:5.

2026-11-24-tue (thumbnail and card): the in-game 'GolfPrice AI' badge is cut off and covered by the 'FREE · NO SIGN-UP' banner ('GolfPric', 'GolfPrice Al'), and the 'Par 3 / Davy Jones' panel is half hidden. Fix: crop these out of the screenshot or move the banner so no text overlaps another element.

2026-11-24-tue (card and thumbnail): the course art is a low-resolution screenshot scaled up, so it looks soft and blocky next to a big golf brand's posts. Fix: use a native-resolution capture or a clean redrawn course graphic at the full 1080 size.

2026-11-24-tue (card): the 'WILD NINE' title is jammed against the top edge and sits on top of the lake and green, and the bottom banner is crowded by the game UI. Fix: add clear margin and place the title on a calm area.

2026-11-24-tue (video): no video tooling in the review environment, so the three video frames could not be extracted or viewed. The thumbnail and card use the same screenshot, so fix them and check the video frames for the same clipped UI.
2026-11-24-tue (caption): '1 in 10,000' hole-in-one odds must come from the game's own data; confirm before it goes out. Colours are a consistent green and yellow, which is fine.
2026-11-25-wed and 2026-12-02-wed: x and bluesky captions end '⛳ Https://...' with a capital H. Fix: lower-case 'https' or drop the capital.
2026-12-05-sat: the hook 'You've got 3 seconds' is a game timer and not shopping urgency, so it is not blocked. Check that it does not read as a countdown.
2026-11-26-thu: '£450 under the highest price we've tracked' and '81 days' must match the price history. 'Good time to buy' is a little pushy; consider 'Lowest price we've tracked'.

2026-11-26-thu, 2026-11-28-sat, 2026-11-30-mon, 2026-12-01-tue, 2026-12-05-sat: card, thumbnail and frames were not supplied, so the visual standard is unverified for these. No retailers are named, '#Ad' leads every product caption, and UK spelling and £ formatting are correct.
